ICSE 2027 (Synthetic Fixture) Paper #5 Review Bots and Time to Merge: A Regression Discontinuity Study
===========================================================================

Review #5A [r2]
===========================================================================

Overall merit
-------------
2. Weak reject

Reviewer expertise
------------------
Y. I am knowledgeable in this area.

Paper summary
-------------
The paper investigates how code review bots affect the time to merge in 80 GitHub projects — using a regression discontinuity design around the date each bot was installed.

Strengths
---------
The design is careful and the analysis leverages a large dataset of 210,000 pull requests. The authors report effect sizes with confidence intervals throughout.

Weaknesses
----------
The bots differ in what they check — style, tests, or security — and the paper pools them in one model. A breakdown per bot type would help maintainers harness the findings.

Detailed comments for authors
-----------------------------
Please add the list of bots and their configuration to the replication package, since the installation dates are the core of the design.
